mapper.select: SELECT id, title, selected_kb_ids AS "selectedKbIdsRaw", last_message_at AS "lastMessageAt", created_at AS "createdAt", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM kb_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_conversation(user_id, title, selected_kb_ids) VALUES(#{userId}, #{title}, CAST(#{selectedKbIds} AS bigint[]))
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_conversation SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE kb_conversation SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM kb_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
